A newline inside two nested spans after an emphasis still separates the words on either side

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><i>Alpha</i><span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>")
puts result.content.inspect
```
